title: Expose safe, typed visible progress

figma.visual_check: not_applicable: F-06 owns producer and adapter; D-15 owns rendering

status.publication: Stacked PR against brief/f-05; exact head and remote checks are recorded in its description.

dependencies.reason: Owner-approved unmerged stack supersedes origin/main start. The producer uses F-03 transport/replay and the browser adapter uses F-04 state. F-05 is the stack parent, not a requirement to enable attachments. D-15 owns rendering.

activation.readiness: Actual live transport provider plus enabled conversation/chatTransport dependencies; gate captured at turn admission.

implementation: Optional asynchronous execution observations for actual tool dispatch, turn-bound sub-agent lifecycle and scoped task broadcasts; detached AgentTaskManager work clears turn progress while retaining execution/authority scope.
Bounded fixed-label projection with host UUIDs, immutable order and phases, optional canonical goal/fact/run references, and no arbitrary source prose or full tool arguments.
Durable existing conversation events; indexed per-turn lookup and atomic unfinished-activity settlement with terminal answer on completion, cancellation or restart.
Browser capability discovery, stable ordered rows, terminal immutability and explicit non-live replay metadata for D-15. No production rendering changes.

acceptance.check: Sensitive arguments, fake errors and malicious source text cannot leak into labels
acceptance.evidence: Projection canaries, prototype-like names, actual registry and AgentService failure, authenticated WebSocket bridge, canonical record content exclusion.

acceptance.check: Completed activities remain still and ordered across rehydration
acceptance.evidence: More-than-one-page replay yields identical final rows and terminal answer; delayed starts and duplicate terminals preserve first position; all restored rows have live=false. D-15 must consume this metadata.

acceptance.check: No cross-conversation events or false success after cancellation/restart
acceptance.evidence: Interleaved actual tools, late completion after cancellation, disk database restart, idempotent recovery, tool failure distinct from successful explanatory answer.

acceptance.check: Progress is opt-in and cannot alter execution effects
acceptance.evidence: Enabled/provider matrix, nested disabled and concurrent observer isolation, observer exceptions preserve exact tool return/throw and execution count.

manual_checks.main_and_open_prs: Fetched main and open PRs before implementation; no competing F-06 progress implementation found. F-05 exact dependency head passed its full CI.
manual_checks.visual: No rendering changes; no screenshot claimed. D-15 owns actual motion verification.
manual_checks.external_effects: Isolated databases, temporary-file reads, harmless local shell commands, fake model/sidecar fixtures and headless test-browser sessions only. No user records, desktop actions, live daemon activation or deployment.

limitations: Activity admission is bounded to 128 per turn. Overflow observations are omitted while admitted rows can still finish.
Progress is best-effort under storage/observer failure and does not replace the execution audit ledger.
Completed means a call returned. Legacy adapters must explicitly mark known returned failures; arbitrary returned strings and object shapes are never parsed for status.
Optional references require explicit trusted producer IDs; they are not inferred from arbitrary tool arguments or results.
Agent pause or exhaustion maps to failed because the contract has only started/completed/failed.
Detached background agent rows are excluded from turn-bound progress; their task manager status/result remains authoritative. The handoff tool itself is observed.
Source data already in model answer text is outside the fixed-label progress projector.
Production UI mounting, presentation, interaction and motion remain D-line work. F-07 is not implemented.
rollback: Disable chatProgress and its future D-15 presentation, preserve historical additive events, and never replay accepted turns or delete user content.

findings_fixed: Removed arbitrary result-content failure inference. Trusted built-in failure branches, local command exit codes, sidecar RPC errors and remote command receipts mark their own invocation without changing returned data or exceptions.

Detached agent execution, nested tools and lifecycle callbacks no longer inherit the parent turn progress observer. Actual background results and execution checkpoints/cancellation signals are preserved.
Added idempotent brief_chat_events(turn_id, sequence) index; fresh and upgraded on-disk vaults retain history and avoid full-table scan and temporary sort during settlement.
